description: Create or update skills the agent follows, all in one place. access { to: "me" } saves them for you, in every project (me:<name>); { to: "team", projectId } saves them for everyone who can open that project (project:<name>). To add one of your skills to a project, load me:<name> and save its body (the text after the frontmatter) and description with team access.

access.description: Where every skill in this call is saved.

to.description: Everyone who can open the project.

content.description: The SKILL.md body in markdown, without frontmatter.

description.description: When to use the skill; the skills list shows it.

files.description: Files to add or replace besides SKILL.md, such as references/fonts.md; [] for none. Other files are kept.

name.description: A lowercase slug such as brand-voice.

name: save_skills
title: Save skills
